title: pvTrivialProducer
body:
## pvTrivialProducer

Wraps an already-existing VTK data object so it can feed a pipeline (vtkTrivialProducer). The data must be attached by native code (SetOutput); authored Schemaxis input cannot do that, so in a workflow this source has nothing to produce. Schemaxis uses the class internally in its writer qualification tool, not as an authoring operation. Use a reader or a source operation for real data.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Schemaxis has no authored way to hand a dataset to a trivial producer, so the node is expected to produce an empty output; this has not been run.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `TrivialProducer`. Identity: `sources/TrivialProducer`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

No authored options.


Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvTrivialProducer"
}
```
